about: Stage R12 (docs/staging/r12-prereg.md section 5): the inputs of the two-call cost estimate. One real decision point (the packet 5 example printed in docs/staging/r8-prereg.md section 10.4, record 48-W50-1670-12, short variant: 362 real tokens by the model's tokenizer, counted in stage R8) rendered as today's single call, as the two calls of this design and as one long call. State lines are the real packet's. The kind labels and the target lists are this design's and are composed by hand in the label grammar of R8 (illustrative, not sampled). scripts/r12-offer-table.ts --calls applies the project's estimator (estimateInputTokens) to each packet and the measured time law to the result.

law.source: the review's speed measurement of 10 October 2026 (model-speed-probe.json: untuned base, 64 held-out packets, one at a time): 0.443 s at a median of 467 tokens; by token tercile 0.34 s at 396, 0.442 s at 466, 0.54 s at 541; a trimmed state of 407 tokens took 0.339 s

realTokens.source: docs/staging/r8-prereg.md section 10.4 (the short variant of the same moment); the mean over 2,572 packets is 0.856 (docs/staging/r8-tokens-day2.md)

asks.source: a 2-day no-model population night with the gate on, field map, seed 48 (docs/staging/r10-prereg.md section 10, proof 6)
the rules' own gate in a rules world, seeds 48 and 7 (docs/staging/r7-ledger-numbers.md section 2)
